title: Add Product Card
content: Create product card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow hover:shadow-lg transition group. Image: aspect-square object-cover, hover zoom effect. Badge: absolute top-2 left-2 for sale/new. Content: p-4. Title: font-semibold truncate. Price: text-lg font-bold, original price strikethrough if on sale. Rating: stars with review count. Actions: Add to Cart button, wishlist heart icon.

variants.simple: Create e-commerce product card with image, price, and actions.
variants.detailed: Create product card. Container: bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow hover:shadow-lg transition group. Image: aspect-square object-cover, hover zoom effect. Badge: absolute top-2 left-2 for sale/new. Content: p-4. Title: font-semibold truncate. Price: text-lg font-bold, original price strikethrough if on sale. Rating: stars with review count. variants.advanced: Create versatile product card component. Image section: aspect-square container, lazy loaded image, skeleton placeholder, hover to show secondary image (if available), zoom on hover. Badges: stackable - "Sale", "New", "Sold Out", percentage off, positioned top-left. Quick actions: overlay on hover - quick view, add to wishlist, compare. Wishlist: heart icon, filled when in wishlist, optimistic toggle. Color swatches: show available colors, click to change displayed image. Rating: star display with average, review count link. Price: current price, compare-at price (strikethrough), discount percentage. Variants preview: size availability dots. Add to cart: button, changes to "Added" briefly, if variants required opens quick-add modal. Stock status: "In Stock", "Low Stock" (3 left), "Out of Stock" with disabled add button. Quick add modal: select size/color, quantity, add to cart without leaving page. Responsive: adjust card size per breakpoint. Accessibility: proper alt text, buttons labeled, keyboard navigable. Skeleton: loading state matching card layout. Product link: entire card clickable except action buttons.
